data_quality_criteria.integrity: source commit and file Git SHA; actual byte SHA-256 from executed artifact; no self-reported hash-only shortcut
data_quality_criteria.model: real model ID, weight hash, runtime commit/tag and binary hash, seed/temp, raw output+hash, schema validity separately
data_quality_criteria.independent_oracle: gold frozen before test and inaccessible to all predictors; independent label authority; do not call retrospective 10 source-authored or published development cases independent holdout
data_quality_criteria.causality: exact same target input across A/B,C/D; only target engine replaced in E; all nontarget engines pin stable; changed downstream values are expected but engine source must not change
data_quality_criteria.S3: full-set recall and exact set separately, COMPETING and EQUIVALENT, no valid-first prefix, runtime semantics genuine
data_quality_criteria.S4: independently source-attested exhaustive bounded mandatory conditions incl positive proof none; real closure and execution proof; all false-close cases in denominator
data_quality_criteria.negative_controls: gold leakage, missing candidate, swapped engine, non-target Oracle, omitted obligations, changed hash, unsupported language/intent, skewed-class trivial predictor
